description: ChatGPT subscription whose ID token has no chatgpt_plan_type claim: the account is the free plan, so the request offers no hosted image_generation tool, as today's core does.
source: core/internal/watcher/synthesizer/file.go (a codex auth file with an ID token and no plan_type reads the plan from the token; a token that does not give one is free)
core/internal/auth/codex/jwt_parser.go (GetPlanType: a missing, null or blank chatgpt_plan_type is the free plan)
core/internal/runtime/executor/codex_executor_request.go (isCodexFreePlanAuth and ensureImageGenerationToolDoc: no image_generation tool for a free plan)

exceptions.reason: The new core's Codex extension asks the upstream only for gzip, which Go's HTTP client decodes itself; today's core also advertises deflate, br and zstd.

When the client names no session, both cores derive a prompt cache key from the conversation's start so every turn of it shares the upstream's prompt cache; today's core hashes its own session identity (client key and canonical content), the new core's Codex extension the account, the model and the first developer and user messages. The values differ; each core's is stable across a conversation.
